response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, including Java and JVM-related work in past roles, but lacks explicit, recent, or deep focus on enterprise Java/Kotlin tooling, Spring, or IDE internals — his recent work is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no clear evidence of contributing to IDE subsystems or JVM tooling at scale.
strengths: Demonstrated experience with Java in past roles (e.g., National Instruments, Altom)
Strong track record in developer tooling, testing frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure
Active open-source contributor with deep interest in developer experience and education
concerns: No recent or prominent Java/Kotlin IDE or JVM tooling work in last 3+ years
Primary recent stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, not enterprise JVM ecosystems
Lacks demonstrable experience with Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or application server integration
